about.title: About SkillVerse
about.content1: SkillVerse was built to solve a critical problem facing millions of learners worldwide: overwhelming choice paralysis in tech and modern digital careers. With thousands of courses, bootcamps, and frameworks competing for attention, figuring out where to start—and what to learn next—can consume weeks of fruitless research.
about.content2: Our tool takes a deterministic, client-side approach. By evaluating your core cognitive preferences, natural problem-solving habits, and existing skill inventory across five core digital industries (Programming, Product Design, Data Science, Digital Marketing, and Business Management), SkillVerse precisely calculates your best-fit field.
about.content3: 100% Client-Side Privacy: We believe your career data is yours. SkillVerse performs all calculation engine scoring entirely within your browser memory. No sign-ups, no databases, no server requests, and no tracking. You get an instant, actionable, PDF-exportable roadmap backed by top-tier free community resources.

privacy.clientSideDataBody: Your questionnaire responses and assessment results are calculated strictly on your device inside browser memory. SkillVerse does not store, transmit, or record your answers on any remote server.
